title: feat(plugin-auth): multi-org Create User joins an organization in the same step, defaulting to the admin's current one
body:
Refs #25625 (close it by hand once this merges: the branch name is fixed by the session, so it cannot carry the `claude/issue-N-…` claim the closing-target guard reads)

## What changes for the admin

In multi-org mode, **Users → Create User** now adds the new user to an organization in the same step, so the follow-up **Add Member** is no longer needed.

- The dialog gains an optional **Organization** picker, shown only in multi-org mode (`features.multiOrgEnabled`). Left empty, the user joins the administrator's current organization.
- Single-org creation, self sign-up, bulk import, SSO sign-in and invitations are unchanged.

## How

- `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` accepts an optional `organizationId`:

  | Request | Joins |
  |:---|:---|
  | `organizationId` given | that organization |
  | omitted, multi-org (`tenancy.isolationActive`), policy `auto` | the caller's active organization; none when they have none |
  | omitted, single-org (a degraded wall included) | unchanged: the default organization |
  | omitted, policy `invite-only` | none |

- The join goes through better-auth's own `addMember` (the Add Member act) as `member`, inside the account's transaction. A refused join returns the vendor's status and code, and no user is created. An existing membership is kept (`membershipCreated: false`).
- A request that names an organization on a server without the organization plugin or a unit of work gets `501` before any account exists. A defaulted organization is skipped there instead.
- **ADR-0093:** D3 gains an amendment recording the maintainer's decision for this endpoint. The reconciler and every other creation path still bind nothing in multi-org mode.
- `@objectstack/spec` books the param under `multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs`. Translations for zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES are included.

## Verification

- Unit: `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts` has 16 new cases: explicit, default, no active org, invite-only, existing membership, vendor refusal rollback, 501s, single-org unchanged, and the dialog param. spec, platform-objects and plugin-auth suites all pass.
- Dogfood: the new `create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts` runs on a real `isolated` stack and covers chosen, defaulted-to-current and refused-with-rollback. The existing create-user, permission-set, reconciler, audit, self-registration and sign-up dogfoods pass (45 tests).
- `pnpm lint`, typecheck, `check:i18n`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:empty-changeset` pass.

## Landing

This diff touches `docs/adr/**` (Tier H). It lands only after an authorized approving review. No AI seat queues it before that.
